controles.affirmation: Litige EO Illinois : 48,2 M$ de reglement, 'paiements en cours', 'reste un point de vigilance residuel'
controles.verbatim_source: Subsequent to quarter-end, the Company made payments, consistent with amounts previously accrued, pursuant to the Settlement Agreements. As of July 31, 2026, substantially all payment obligations of the Company under the Settlement Agreements have been satisfied, and the claims administration process has been largely completed. Accordingly, substantially all of the personal injury claims subject to the Settlement Agreements have been dismissed with prejudice. (10-Q T1 FY2027, note Litiges)
controles.correction_proposee: Titre : 'Litige environnemental EO en Illinois : 48,2 M$ de reglement, quasi solde au 31 juillet 2026'. Argument : preciser qu'au 31 juillet 2026 la quasi-totalite des paiements est effectuee et que la quasi-totalite des plaintes est rejetee avec prejudice (donc non rejugeables) ; supprimer 'paiements en cours' et attenuer 'point de vigilance residuel'.

controles.affirmation: Une filiale de STERIS a ete poursuivie par des riverains d'une usine EO a Waukegan, Illinois, cancers allegues, emissions entre janvier 2005 et septembre 2008
controles.verbatim_source: A subsidiary of the Company was sued in Illinois state court by individual plaintiffs who worked or resided near a facility in Lake County, Illinois, where the subsidiary provided sterilization services using ethylene oxide (EO) from January 2005 to September 2008. The plaintiffs filed separate suits in which each alleged that they were diagnosed with one or more types of cancer
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance mineure facultative : les plaignants sont des personnes qui 'travaillaient ou residaient a proximite' (pas uniquement des riverains). Waukegan est bien dans Lake County (cite plus loin dans la note).

controles.affirmation: 48,2 M$ acceptes pour regler les plaintes, charge comptabilisee sur l'exercice 2025, pas de reconnaissance de responsabilite
controles.verbatim_source: the Company agreed to pay up to $48.2 million to settle claims. We recorded a charge for this amount in fiscal 2025 ... None of the Settlement Agreements are an admission of liability

controles.affirmation: Plan de restructuration annonce le 5 aout 2026 : fermeture St. Louis (MO) et Plymouth (MN), 55 a 70 M$ de charges avant impots dont 40 a 50 M$ en tresorerie, achevement au cours de l'exercice 2030
controles.verbatim_source: The Consolidation Plan includes the anticipated closure of chemistry manufacturing and distribution facilities in St. Louis, Missouri, and Plymouth, Minnesota. The Company currently expects to incur total pre-tax restructuring charges of approximately $55 million to $70 million, consisting of approximately $40 million to $50 million of cash expenditures ... with completion anticipated to occur during fiscal 2030 (8-K du 5 aout 2026, Item 2.05)

controles.verbatim_source: As of June 30, 2026, the transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations was approximately $1,541.4 million (vs $1,824.0 million au 30/06/2025, 10-Q T1 FY2026) ; Healthcare backlog 444.0 (vs 403.5) + Life Sciences backlog 109.9 (vs 111.0) = 553,9 vs 514,5
controles.correction_proposee: Le 'backlog total' de 553,9 M$ n'est pas publie tel quel : c'est la somme des backlogs Healthcare et Life Sciences. Le preciser.

controles.affirmation: Marges : AST 48,0% (-0,6 pt), Life Sciences 42,1% (-1,3 pt), Healthcare 24,8% (+0,6 pt), marge groupe 19,1% (+1,4 pt)
controles.verbatim_source: Healthcare $260.2 / $235.5 ; AST 142.9 / 136.7 ; Life Sciences 61.8 / 58.7 (income from operations before adjustments) ; revenus segments 1 048,3 / 297,6 / 146,7. Calculs : AST 48,0% vs 48,6% ; LS 42,1% vs 43,4% ; HC 24,8% vs 24,2%
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : la marge groupe passe de 17,7% a 19,1%, soit +1,5 pt et non +1,4 pt ; par ailleurs les marges de segment sont calculees sur le resultat 'before adjustments' alors que la marge groupe utilise le resultat operationnel publie (285,8 M$) : les deux bases ne sont pas homogenes.
